name: 双幅飞鸟
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN" class="theme-flight"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><meta name="author" content="九一"><title>___JIUYI_HOME_title___ · 双幅飞鸟</title><style>@font-face{font-family:OpeningSong;src:url('___JIUYI_ASSET___01fa3ffff6c44b59483b.woff2') format('woff2');font-weight:400;font-display:swap}
:root{color-scheme:light;--paper:#fff;--ink:#303130;--muted:#73756f;--rule:#9a9c95;--faint:#d7d8d3;--outside:#f7f7f6}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{background:var(--outside);scroll-behavior:auto}
body{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.8 OpeningSong,'Songti SC',serif;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
h1,h2,h3,p,figure,dl,dd{margin:0}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:400}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button,input,textarea{font:inherit}
a,button,summary,input,textarea{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:#c9cbd533}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
.asset-definitions{position:absolute;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.home-shell{width:min(100% - 40px,760px);margin:24px auto 32px}
.edition{background:var(--paper);container-type:inline-size;isolation:isolate}
.micro{font:9px/1.55 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;letter-spacing:1.7px}
.arrow{font:22px/1 Georgia,serif;display:inline-block}
.cover-page{padding:26px 40px 24px;overflow:hidden}
.cover-masthead,.cover-colophon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.cover-masthead{min-height:28px}
.cover-colophon{padding-top:26px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.cover-colophon .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.2px}
.work-title{font-size:38px;letter-spacing:5px;line-height:1.55;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.work-title.is-long{font-size:28px;letter-spacing:2px}
.cover-subtitle,.page-subtitle{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8}
.cover-open{display:block;position:relative}
.cover-open-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:54px;font-size:12px}
.cover-open-footer .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1px}
.cover-open-footer .arrow{font-size:17px;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:10px}
.pages-view,.reader-view{padding:23px 36px 22px}
.page-topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;min-height:45px;font-size:12px}
.page-topbar>a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px}
.page-topbar>.micro{font-size:8px;text-align:right;max-width:54%}
.pages-title{padding:28px 0 27px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--rule)}
.pages-title .page-subtitle{margin-top:4px}
.credits{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.7fr 1fr 1.15fr;gap:16px;padding:19px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--faint)}
.credits>div{min-width:0}
.credits dt{font-size:10px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.credits dd{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.intro-column,.contents-column{min-width:0}
.section-label{margin-bottom:8px}
.intro-column h2,.contents-header h2{font-size:26px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:2px}
.story-intro{font-size:15px;line-height:2.05;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;letter-spacing:.3px}
.intro-column>.story-intro{margin-top:18px}
.contents-header{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-bottom:20px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--rule)}
.contents-header h2{margin-top:7px}
.contents-count{font:italic 33px/1 Georgia,serif;color:var(--muted);padding-bottom:4px}
.opening-entry{border-bottom:1px solid var(--faint)}
.entry-link{display:block;padding:20px 0;min-height:100px;transition:opacity .18s}
.entry-link:hover{opacity:.7}
.entry-top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--muted)}
.entry-number{font:italic 15px/1.4 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:0}
.entry-link h3{font-size:23px;letter-spacing:1px;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin-top:9px}
.entry-summary{font-size:14px;line-height:1.95;margin-top:8px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.entry-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;margin-top:15px}
.entry-bottom>.arrow{font-size:21px}
.contents-footer{padding-top:18px;text-align:right;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px}
.empty-note{padding:25px 0;font-size:13px}
.edition-tail{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:32px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--faint)}
.edition-tail .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.1px}
.print-mark{font:28px/1 Georgia,serif}
.reader-heading{padding:35px 0 0}
.reader-route{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--muted)}
.reader-heading h2{font-size:36px;line-height:1.65;letter-spacing:3px;margin:9px 0 20px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.reader-line{display:block;width:48px;height:2px;background:var(--ink)}
.reader-text{font-size:17px;line-height:2.1;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;padding:35px 0 55px;min-height:260px;letter-spacing:.6px}
.reader-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding:15px 0 10px}
.reader-footer>p{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.reader-footer nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-top:16px;font-size:12px}
.reader-footer nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px}
.sample-caption{font:11px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin:22px 12px 14px}
.sample-editor{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--paper);padding:0 18px;font:13px/1.7 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.sample-editor summary{min-height:48px;padding:13px 0;cursor:pointer}
.editor-body{padding:4px 0 18px}
.editor-body>p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:18px}
.editor-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.editor-field{display:grid;gap:5px;min-width:0}
.editor-field.wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.editor-field input,.editor-field textarea{width:100%;min-width:0;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:0;padding:9px;font-size:16px}
.editor-field textarea{min-height:86px;resize:vertical}
.editor-body h3{font:600 13px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;margin:20px 0 10px}
.noscript-note{text-align:center;font:13px/1.8 system-ui,sans-serif;padding:20px}
@media(max-width:480px){
 .home-shell{width:100%;margin:0 auto 24px}.cover-page{padding:22px 24px}.pages-view,.reader-view{padding:15px 22px 23px}
 .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.4px}.cover-masthead{min-height:26px}.work-title{font-size:33px;letter-spacing:4px}.work-title.is-long{font-size:25px;letter-spacing:1.5px}
 .cover-subtitle,.page-subtitle{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px}.cover-colophon{font-size:10px;padding-top:20px}.cover-colophon .micro{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1px}
 .page-topbar{font-size:11px}.page-topbar>.micro{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1px}.pages-title{padding:22px 0}.credits{gap:12px;padding:17px 0}.credits dd{font-size:11px}.credits dt{font-size:9px;margin-bottom:4px}
 .story-intro{font-size:14px}.intro-column h2,.contents-header h2{font-size:24px}.entry-link h3{font-size:22px}.entry-summary{font-size:13px}.reader-text{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.3px}.reader-heading h2{font-size:32px}
 .sample-editor{margin-inline:16px}.sample-caption{font-size:10px}
}
@media(max-width:350px){.cover-page{padding-inline:18px}.pages-view,.reader-view{padding-inline:18px}.credits{gap:8px}.credits dd{font-size:10px}.page-topbar>.micro{max-width:48%}.work-title{font-size:29px;letter-spacing:3px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

:root{color-scheme:dark;--paper:#0b0e18;--ink:#f1efe5;--muted:#b7b8b5;--rule:#a4a6a6;--faint:#424653;--outside:#10131b;--night-page:#f3f1e8;--night-ink:#202735}
.theme-flight .edition{border:1px solid #4f5360}
.theme-flight .cover-page{padding:24px 40px 26px}
.theme-flight .micro{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px}
.theme-flight .cover-masthead{padding-bottom:13px;border-bottom:2px solid #a8aaa555}
.theme-flight .cover-masthead .micro{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.8px;color:#c5c5bd}
.theme-flight .cover-heading{padding-top:38px;text-align:center}
.cover-kicker{font:10px/1.5 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:2.6px;color:#b5b8c1;margin-bottom:13px}
.theme-flight .cover-heading .work-title{font-size:54px;letter-spacing:4px;line-height:1.3}
.theme-flight .cover-heading .work-title.is-long{font-size:36px;letter-spacing:2px}
.theme-flight .cover-heading .cover-subtitle{margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:4px}
.flight-stage{position:relative;isolation:isolate;height:450px;margin:32px auto 22px;max-width:510px;overflow:visible}
.flight-strip{position:absolute;width:28%;overflow:hidden;background-color:#161b2a;border:1.5px solid #c6c8be80;transition:transform .65s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),opacity .6s}
.flight-strip::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:5px;border:1px solid #d5d5c12e;pointer-events:none}
.strip-left{left:20%;top:0;height:83%;background-image:radial-gradient(#c1c1ae60 .65px,transparent .8px);background-size:8px 8px}
.strip-right{left:55%;top:16%;height:82%;background-color:#262c38;background-image:radial-gradient(#d2cfba3d .65px,transparent .8px);background-size:7px 7px}
.strip-cloud{position:absolute;max-width:none;width:235%;height:auto;left:-126%;bottom:-2%}
.strip-right .strip-cloud{width:270%;left:-105%;bottom:-10%}
.strip-serial{position:absolute;top:10px;left:12px;z-index:1;font:10px/1 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:2px;color:#eae8d8}
.night-stars{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;color:#e4e0cb;pointer-events:none}
.flight-bird{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;transform-origin:50% 50%;transition:transform .68s cubic-bezier(.22,.1,.3,1),opacity .6s}
.bird-main{width:39%;left:5%;top:43%;z-index:3;transform:rotate(-12deg)}
.stage-note{position:absolute;font:9px/1.5 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#a8adb9;writing-mode:vertical-rl}
.note-left{left:7%;top:4%}.note-right{right:5%;top:40%}
.book-icon{width:24px;height:23px;flex:0 0 24px}
.theme-flight .cover-colophon{border-top:1px solid #343a47;padding-top:16px;margin-top:28px;font-size:12px}
.theme-flight .cover-colophon .micro{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px}

/* A light preface leaf and darker, folding chapter slips. */
.theme-flight .pages-view{padding:21px 30px 28px}
.theme-flight .page-topbar>a{gap:9px;font-size:13px}
.theme-flight .page-topbar .book-icon{width:20px;height:20px;flex-basis:20px}
.theme-flight .pages-title{padding:28px 0 20px;border-bottom:2px solid #d6d4c6;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:18px}
.theme-flight .pages-title .work-title{font-size:37px;letter-spacing:2px;line-height:1.45}
.theme-flight .pages-title .work-title.is-long{font-size:28px}
.theme-flight .pages-title .page-subtitle{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;flex:0 0 auto;padding-bottom:6px}
.theme-flight .credits{grid-template-columns:.7fr 1fr 1.15fr;gap:18px;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #737786}
.theme-flight .credits dt{font-size:11px;color:#b1b5be;margin-bottom:5px}
.theme-flight .credits dd{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}
.theme-flight .spread{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.88fr) minmax(0,1.12fr);gap:24px;align-items:start;padding-top:30px}
.theme-flight .intro-column{padding:0;border:0}
.intro-paper{background:var(--night-page);color:var(--night-ink);padding:20px 21px 17px;border-top:4px solid #c7c8bb;position:relative;box-shadow:4px 5px 0 #2c3242}
.intro-running-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:23px}
.intro-running-head .micro{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px}
.intro-seal{display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:15px;line-height:1.3;border:1px solid #727a83;outline:1px solid #727a83;outline-offset:2px;width:23px;height:27px}
.theme-flight .intro-column h2{font-size:30px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:1.5px}
.intro-rule{display:block;width:29px;height:2px;background:var(--night-ink);margin:22px 0}
.theme-flight .intro-paper .story-intro{margin:0;color:var(--night-ink);font-size:16px;line-height:1.95;letter-spacing:.2px}
.intro-paper-foot{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;border-top:1px solid #7e828772;margin-top:30px;padding-top:15px}
.intro-paper-foot .micro{font-size:8px;line-height:1.8;letter-spacing:1px;color:#555f6a}
.paper-star{font:26px/1 Georgia,serif}
.reading-note{margin:25px 0 0;border-top:1px dashed #7b8190;border-bottom:1px dashed #7b8190}
.reading-note summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;min-height:47px;font-size:13px}
.reading-note summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.note-toggle{font:19px/1 Georgia,serif;transition:transform .2s}
.reading-note[open] .note-toggle{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.reading-note p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;color:#c0c3cd;padding:0 0 15px}
.theme-flight .contents-header{padding-bottom:16px;border-bottom:2px solid #cccbbd}
.theme-flight .contents-header .micro{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px}
.theme-flight .contents-header h2{font-size:28px;letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:8px}
.theme-flight .contents-count{font-size:29px;color:#bebfb6}
.contents-hint{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#b8bdc9;padding:13px 0 20px}
.theme-flight .opening-list{display:grid;gap:16px}
.theme-flight .opening-entry{border:0}
.chapter-sheet{border:1.5px solid #9299a4;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#191f2d;position:relative}
.chapter-tab{display:block;list-style:none;padding:15px 17px 14px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;min-height:123px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.chapter-tab::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.chapter-folio{font:italic 17px/1.4 Georgia,serif;display:inline-block;margin-right:10px;color:#d8d9d0}
.theme-flight .entry-route{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#babfca}
.chapter-tab h3{font-size:28px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:1px;margin:10px 0 9px;padding-right:7px}
.fold-mark{position:absolute;right:-1px;top:-1px;width:19px;height:19px;background:linear-gradient(45deg,#bdc0bd 0 47%,#7b838c 49% 52%,var(--paper) 54%);border-left:1px solid #abb2b5;border-bottom:1px solid #abb2b5;transform-origin:top right;transition:width .2s,height .2s}
.chapter-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#b9bfcb;margin-top:15px}
.chapter-toggle i{position:relative;display:block;width:15px;height:15px;flex:0 0 15px}
.chapter-toggle i::before,.chapter-toggle i::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:7px;left:2px;width:11px;height:1px;background:currentColor}
.chapter-toggle i::after{transform:rotate(90deg);transition:transform .2s}
.when-open{display:none}
.chapter-sheet[open] .when-closed{display:none}
.chapter-sheet[open] .when-open{display:inline}
.chapter-sheet[open] .chapter-toggle i::after{transform:rotate(0deg)}
.chapter-sheet[open] .fold-mark{width:25px;height:25px}
.chapter-sheet[open] .chapter-tab{background:#242b3b}
.chapter-body{padding:0 17px 14px;background:#242b3b}
.theme-flight .entry-summary{color:#e2e2da;font-size:15px;line-height:1.9;letter-spacing:.1px;margin:0;padding:4px 0 18px}
.theme-flight .entry-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:45px;padding:9px 11px;margin:0;background:#efede1;color:#202735;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;border:1px solid #e3e1d6;transition:background .15s,transform .15s}
.theme-flight .entry-link:hover{opacity:1;background:#fffdf4}
.theme-flight .entry-link:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.theme-flight .entry-link .book-icon{width:19px;height:20px;flex-basis:19px}
.chapter-read-label{font:8px/1.3 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:1px;margin-left:auto}
.theme-flight .was-viewed .entry-link{background:transparent;color:#e6e5d9;border-color:#8992a1}
.theme-flight .contents-footer{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;padding-top:20px}
.theme-flight .edition-tail{margin-top:35px;border-top:2px solid #7b818a;padding-top:16px}
.theme-flight .edition-tail .micro{font-size:9px}

/* The reading view is a separate printed leaf. */
.theme-flight .reader-view{padding:20px 30px 30px;background:var(--paper)}
.reading-leaf{background:var(--night-page);color:var(--night-ink);border-top:4px solid #c7c8bb;padding:22px 34px 25px;margin-top:20px;box-shadow:5px 6px 0 #303746;animation:leaf-open .32s ease-out both}
.theme-flight .reader-heading{padding-top:12px}
.theme-flight .reader-route{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#65707b}
.theme-flight .reader-heading h2{font-size:40px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:10px}
.theme-flight .reader-line{width:36px;height:2px;background:var(--night-ink)}
.theme-flight .reader-text{font-size:18px;line-height:2.15;letter-spacing:.2px;padding:28px 0 37px;min-height:280px}
.leaf-end{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:15px;font:23px/1 Georgia,serif;color:#6c747b;margin-bottom:25px}
.leaf-end span{height:1px;width:28px;background:#8a8c88}
.theme-flight .reader-footer{border-top:1px solid #9da09c}
.theme-flight .reader-footer>p{color:#68717b;font-size:11px}
.theme-flight .reader-footer nav{gap:10px}
.theme-flight .reader-footer nav a{font-size:14px;gap:8px;min-height:46px;padding:6px 0;line-height:1.5}
.theme-flight .reader-footer nav a[data-next-opening]{padding:8px 12px;background:#202735;color:#f1efe5}
.theme-flight .reader-footer .book-icon{width:18px;height:20px;flex-basis:18px}
.theme-flight .is-opening .bird-main{transform:translate(-155%,-155%) rotate(-24deg) scale(.85);opacity:0}
.theme-flight .is-opening .strip-left{transform:translateX(-65px) rotate(-3deg);opacity:0}
.theme-flight .is-opening .strip-right{transform:translateX(65px) rotate(3deg);opacity:0}
@keyframes leaf-open{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(9px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media(max-width:480px){
 .theme-flight .edition{border:0}.theme-flight .cover-page{padding:23px 24px 22px}.theme-flight .cover-masthead .micro{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.4px}
 .theme-flight .cover-heading{padding-top:29px}.cover-kicker{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin-bottom:13px}
 .theme-flight .cover-heading .work-title{font-size:43px;letter-spacing:3px}.theme-flight .cover-heading .work-title.is-long{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:2px}
 .theme-flight .cover-heading .cover-subtitle{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:3px;margin-top:12px}
 .flight-stage{height:350px;margin:28px auto 20px}.stage-note{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.3px}.bird-main{width:41%;left:3%;top:44%}
 .theme-flight .cover-colophon{margin-top:25px;font-size:12px}.theme-flight .cover-colophon .micro{font-size:9px}
 .theme-flight .pages-view{padding:16px 20px 25px}.theme-flight .page-topbar>.micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1px}
 .theme-flight .pages-title{padding:23px 0 17px;display:block}.theme-flight .pages-title .work-title{font-size:34px;letter-spacing:2px}.theme-flight .pages-title .page-subtitle{font-size:12px;margin-top:5px;padding:0}
 .theme-flight .credits{gap:12px;padding:19px 0}.theme-flight .credits dt{font-size:10px}.theme-flight .credits dd{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8}
 .theme-flight .spread{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.86fr) minmax(0,1.14fr);gap:16px;padding-top:25px}
 .intro-paper{padding:16px 14px 14px;box-shadow:3px 4px 0 #2c3242}.intro-running-head{margin-bottom:21px;display:block}.intro-running-head .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.8px}.intro-seal{margin-top:16px;width:22px;height:26px;font-size:14px}
 .theme-flight .intro-column h2{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:.6px;line-height:1.5}.intro-rule{margin:20px 0}.theme-flight .intro-paper .story-intro{font-size:15px;line-height:1.95;letter-spacing:0}
 .intro-paper-foot{margin-top:25px;gap:6px;align-items:flex-end}.intro-paper-foot .micro{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.5px}.paper-star{font-size:22px}
 .reading-note{margin-top:23px}.reading-note summary{font-size:12px}.reading-note p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.85}
